what_happened: Direct timed measurement (6 foreground Bash calls, timeout param=600000, durations 10/170/190/350/590/620s) refuted the dispatch's carried ~180s backgrounding figure and confirmed the documented 600s ceiling exactly, including the harness's own backgrounding message naming 600s. Closed as no-change per the dispatch's own pre-authorized disposition for this outcome.

Premise re-validation in the plan phase cheaply confirmed two description claims the research phase had left unchecked: the territory edges onto 454 and 439 are genuinely present in state.json (field name is 'dependencies', not 'depends_on'), and archive/392 holds a full 10-phase delivery of the 600000 instruction, confirming the figure was deliberate rather than incidental. Both strengthen the no-change disposition at near-zero cost.

Two counts carried in the dispatch description re-derived differently: the bullet-carrier set is 24 files (23 agent bodies plus the pattern source), not 29; and nine markdown files under agent-system/extensions bear 600000, one more than the description's list implies (lean/agents/lean-implementation-agent.md is omitted from it). Neither triggers action since the propagation obligation never activated, but both are recorded in the plan's Premise Re-Validation table so a future propagation pass does not inherit the stale figures.

A bracketed first-hand re-measurement (10s/170s/190s/350s/590s synchronous, 620s backgrounded, all with the Bash tool's timeout parameter raised to 600000) refuted the carried ~180s ceiling figure from the originating consumer-repo issue entry before any guidance edit was made. The research and plan phases correctly identified this as a successful no-change close, avoiding a destabilizing rebase of the 3a/3b sub-case split onto a wrong number; implementation recorded the measurement as dated provenance instead.

During Phase 3 verification, a foreground 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh' invocation (no inner timeout wrapper, tool timeout parameter left at the harness default) was auto-backgrounded by the harness after exceeding roughly 120s wall time; stopped via TaskStop rather than left to complete. Not chased further, since the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive already exempted this final full-tier phase from running the complete gate set independently -- the scoped narrowing (lint-agent-contracts.sh plus the five named regression suites) was used instead, per directive.
